name: ayin
description: AYIN global web-first streaming and creator platform

scripts.build: corepack pnpm packages:build && corepack pnpm --filter @ayin/api run build && corepack pnpm --filter @ayin/web run build
scripts.dev: corepack pnpm packages:build && corepack pnpm --parallel --filter @ayin/api --filter @ayin/web run dev
scripts.dev:api: corepack pnpm packages:build && corepack pnpm --filter @ayin/api run dev
scripts.dev:web: corepack pnpm packages:build && corepack pnpm --filter @ayin/web run dev
scripts.test:integration: corepack pnpm --filter @ayin/db run test:integration && corepack pnpm --filter @ayin/api run test:integration
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm packages:build && corepack pnpm --filter @ayin/api run typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @ayin/web run typecheck
